name: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Limited

annual_report.business: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Limited is a manufacturer and exporter of stainless-steel products including washers, precision fasteners, finishing sheets, tubes, pipes, and sheet metal components, operating five fully integrated manufacturing facilities in Gujarat with an annual processing capacity of approximately 46,668 MT.

capacity_or_capex.item: Phase-II capex for existing product capacity enhancement
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Repayment over 36 quarterly installments commencing from September 2026

guidance_or_targets.statement: Commenced manufacturing of nuts and bolts

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Dies and tools capitalized during the year are self-generated assets amounting to Rs. 568.17 million as certified by MR. Upendra Nath Mahto

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk - risk that revenue is recognized on sale of goods before control in the goods is transferred
Dependence on global OEM customers across 31 countries
Raw material price volatility in stainless steel
Foreign exchange risk from exports to Europe, North America, Asia Pacific and Middle East

latest_guidance.statement: CCL project scaled case revenue Rs 750+ Cr, EBITDA Rs 150 Cr (20%), PAT Rs 83 Cr (11%), ROI 29%
CCL project Phase 1 revenue Rs 108 Cr, EBITDA Rs 22 Cr (20%), PAT Rs 12 Cr (11%), ROI 29%
Management guided for FY28 consolidated revenue of ₹2,500 crore with 14% EBITDA and 11% PAT, but said new guidance with higher margins will be announced very soon.
Management expects FY27 PAT margin around 6.25% and tax rate near last year's ~15%.
Management targets base business revenue of ₹1,315 crore in FY27 and ₹1,800 crore by FY28.
